research_mode: official UK government and ONS primary statistical releases and methodology only; every claim carries a fail-closed limitation; no parcel result, exact incident location, candidate value, local risk score or business result claimed

sources.name: Modern-slavery bulletin period
verified_claims: The bulletin covers NRM and Duty to Notify activity from 1 January to 31 March 2026.
limitations: Quarterly referrals are not a count of all modern-slavery victims.

sources.name: NRM referrals total
verified_claims: The NRM received 6,003 potential-victim referrals in quarter 1 of 2026.
limitations: Referrals represent people identified and referred, not underlying prevalence.

sources.name: Competent-authority referral split
verified_claims: Seventy-four percent of referrals went to the SCA and 26% to the IECA.
limitations: The authority split reflects routing and eligibility, not local risk.

sources.name: Most-referred nationalities
verified_claims: UK, Eritrean and Somali nationals were the most frequently referred nationalities in the quarter.
limitations: Nationality is self or administratively recorded and must not be used for individual prediction.

sources.name: UK-national referral record
verified_claims: Quarter 1 of 2026 had the highest quarterly number of UK-national referrals since the NRM began.
limitations: Higher referrals may reflect awareness, identification or exploitation and no single driver is established.

sources.name: UK-only exploitation referrals
verified_claims: There were 2,448 referrals reporting exploitation exclusively in the UK, the highest quarterly total since the NRM began.
limitations: Reported exploitation location is referral information, not an exact incident coordinate.

sources.name: Reasonable-grounds decisions
verified_claims: The Home Office issued 5,990 reasonable-grounds decisions, 65% positive.
limitations: Decision proportions depend on the applicable evidential test and case mix.

sources.name: Conclusive-grounds decisions
verified_claims: The Home Office issued 5,680 conclusive-grounds decisions, 68% positive.
limitations: Decisions in a quarter do not necessarily relate to referrals made in that quarter.

sources.name: Cases awaiting decision
verified_claims: There were 4,726 cases awaiting a decision at the end of March 2026.
limitations: The waiting stock is a point-in-time operational measure.

sources.name: Median age of awaiting cases
verified_claims: The median age of cases awaiting a conclusive-grounds decision was 53 days.
limitations: A median does not describe every case or guarantee completion time.

sources.name: Duty to Notify total
verified_claims: The Home Office received 1,628 Duty to Notify reports of adult potential victims.
limitations: DtN reports cover non-consenting adults and are not directly additive to NRM referrals.

sources.name: Pre-2014 reliability boundary
verified_claims: Granular data before 2014 are excluded because they were not quality assured to the same standard.
limitations: Long-term comparisons should start from the supported period.

sources.name: Modern-slavery definition
verified_claims: The bulletin uses modern slavery to include human trafficking, slavery, servitude and forced labour under the Modern Slavery Act 2015.
limitations: The statistical category does not establish a final legal finding in each referral.

sources.name: Authorised first responders
verified_claims: Authorised first responders include local authorities, specified NGOs, police forces and specified government agencies.
limitations: Only potential victims brought to an authorised responder's attention can enter these statistics.

sources.name: NRM consent rule
verified_claims: Adults must consent to NRM referral, while children aged 17 and under do not need to consent.
limitations: Differences in consent rules affect age-group comparability.

sources.name: NRM and DtN double-counting boundary
verified_claims: A person can be reported through DtN and later referred to the NRM, so the two totals should not be combined.
limitations: Adding the series can double count potential victims.

sources.name: Hidden-population limitation
verified_claims: NRM and DtN data do not capture all modern-slavery victims because many potential victims remain unidentified.
limitations: Referral totals are not a prevalence estimate.

sources.name: Live-system revision boundary
verified_claims: The statistics are extracted from a live case-management system and may change as new information is recorded.
limitations: Release-date versioning is required for reproducibility.

sources.name: Exploitation-location boundary
verified_claims: UK exploitation locations are grouped to lieutenancy counties using towns and cities reported in referrals.
limitations: The grouped location is not an exact address or parcel location.

sources.name: Multiple-place counting rule
verified_claims: A referral reporting the same place multiple times is counted once, but referrals can report several places.
limitations: Counts across counties or countries should not be added because a referral may appear in more than one area.
